verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا

trs.20: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]
trs.85: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,
trs.22: By the (Winds) that scatter broadcast;
trs.203: By (the winds) that scatter dust.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا

trs.20: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
trs.85: and those that are heavily laden,
trs.22: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;
trs.203: And (the clouds) that bear heavy weight of water.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا

trs.20: And the ships sailing with ease
trs.85: that speed freely,
trs.22: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;
trs.203: And (the ships) that float with ease and gentleness.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا

trs.20: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
trs.85: that distribute [rain] as ordained!
trs.22: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-
trs.203: And those (angels) who distribute (provisions, rain, and other blessings) by (Allâh’s) Command.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ

trs.20: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
trs.85: What you [people] are promised is true:
trs.22: Verily that which ye are promised is true;
trs.203: Verily, that which you are promised (i.e. Resurrection in the Hereafter and receiving the reward or punishment of good or bad deeds) is surely true.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

trs.20: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
trs.85: the Judgement will come––
trs.22: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.
trs.203: And verily, the Recompense is sure to happen.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ

trs.20: By the heaven containing pathways,<sup foot_note=197414>1</sup>
trs.85: by the sky with its pathways,
trs.22: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,
trs.203: By the heaven full of paths,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ

trs.20: Indeed, you are in differing speech.<sup foot_note=197415>1</sup>
trs.85: you differ in what you say––
trs.22: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,
trs.203: Certainly, you have different ideas (about Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân).

verses.text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ

trs.20: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
trs.85: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.
trs.22: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.
trs.203: Turned aside therefrom (i.e. from Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân) is he who is turned aside (by the Decree and Preordainment القضاء والقدر of Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ

trs.20: Destroyed are the misinformers<sup foot_note=197416>1</sup>
trs.85: Perish the liars,
trs.22: Woe to the falsehood-mongers,-
trs.203: Cursed be the liars

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ

trs.20: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
trs.85: those steeped in error and unaware!
trs.22: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:
trs.203: Who are under a cover of heedlessness (think not about the gravity of the Hereafter),

verses.text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

trs.20: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
trs.85: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’
trs.22: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"
trs.203: They ask: "When will be the Day of Recompense?"

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

trs.20: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.
trs.85: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,
trs.22: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!
trs.203: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (punished i.e. burnt) over the Fire!

verses.text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

trs.20: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
trs.85: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’
trs.22: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
trs.203: "Taste you your trial (punishment i.e. burning)! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

trs.20: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
trs.85: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.
trs.22: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
trs.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs (in the Paradise),

verses.text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

trs.20: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
trs.85: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:
trs.22: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
trs.203: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112).

verses.text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

trs.20: They used to sleep but little of the night,<sup foot_note=197417>1</sup>
trs.85: sleeping only little at night,
trs.22: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
trs.203: They used to sleep but little by night [invoking their Lord (Allâh) and praying, with fear and hope].

verses.text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

trs.20: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
trs.85: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,
trs.22: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
trs.203: And in the hours before dawn, they were (found) asking (Allâh) for forgiveness.

translation.text: And in the hours before dawn

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

trs.20: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
trs.85: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.
trs.22: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
trs.203: And in their properties there was the right of the Sâ’il (the beggar who asks) and the Mahrûm (the poor who does not ask others)<sup foot_note=154929>1</sup>.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

trs.20: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
trs.85: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––
trs.22: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
trs.203: And on the earth are signs for those who have Faith with certainty.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

trs.20: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
trs.85: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––
trs.22: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
trs.203: And also in your ownselves. Will you not then see?

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
trs.85: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.
trs.22: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
trs.203: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

trs.20: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
trs.85: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.
trs.22: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
trs.203: Then by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth (i.e. what has been promised to you), just as it is the truth that you can speak.

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

trs.20: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?<sup foot_note=197418>1</sup> -
trs.85: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?
trs.22: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
trs.203: Has the story reached you, of the honoured guests [three angels; Jibrîl (Gabriel) along with another two] of Ibrâhîm (Abraham)?

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

trs.20: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."
trs.85: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’
trs.22: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."
trs.203: When they came in to him and said: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)!" He answered: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)," and said: "You are a people unknown to me."

verses.text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ

trs.20: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.
trs.85: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,
trs.22: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,
trs.203: Then he turned to his household, and brought out a roasted calf [as the property of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) was mainly cows].

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

trs.20: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
trs.85: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,
trs.22: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"
trs.203: And placed it before them, (saying): "Will you not eat?"

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

trs.20: And he felt from them apprehension.<sup foot_note=197419>1</sup> They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
trs.85: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.
trs.22: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
trs.203: Then he conceived fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not."<sup foot_note=154930>1</sup> And they gave him glad tidings of a son having knowledge (about Allâh and His religion of True Monotheism).

translation.text: and they gave him glad tidings

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ

trs.20: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
trs.85: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’
trs.22: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"
trs.203: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice: she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"<sup foot_note=154931>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

trs.20: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
trs.85: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’
trs.22: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."
trs.203: They said: "Even so says your Lord.<sup foot_note=154932>1</sup> Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

trs.20: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
trs.85: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’
trs.22: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"
trs.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O Messengers?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

trs.20: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals<sup foot_note=197420>1</sup>
trs.85: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,
trs.22: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-
trs.203: They said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in Allâh)

verses.text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ

trs.20: To send down upon them stones of clay,
trs.85: to bring down rocks of clay,
trs.22: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),
trs.203: To send down upon them stones of baked clay.

verses.text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

trs.20: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
trs.85: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’
trs.22: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."
trs.203: Marked by your Lord for the Musrifûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners - those who trespass Allâh’s set limits in evil-doings by committing great sins).

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.
trs.85: We brought out such believers as were there-
trs.22: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,
trs.203: So We brought out from therein the believers.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

trs.20: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.<sup foot_note=197421>1</sup>
trs.85: We found only one household devoted to God-
trs.22: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:
trs.203: But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one [of Lût (Lot) and his two daughters].

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

trs.20: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
trs.85: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
trs.22: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.
trs.203: And We have left there a sign (i.e. the place of the Dead Sea<sup foot_note=154933>1</sup> in Palestine) for those who fear the painful torment.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.<sup foot_note=197422>1</sup>
trs.85: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
trs.22: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.
trs.203: And in Mûsâ (Moses) (too, there is a sign), when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a manifest authority.

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

trs.20: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."
trs.85: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’
trs.22: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"
trs.203: But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] turned away (from Belief in might) along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer, or a madman."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

trs.20: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
trs.85: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.
trs.22: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
trs.203: So We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, for he was blameworthy.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ

trs.20: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.<sup foot_note=197423>1</sup>
trs.85: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them
trs.22: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:
trs.203: And in ‘Âd (there is also a sign) when We sent against them the barren wind;

verses.text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

trs.20: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
trs.85: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.
trs.22: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
trs.203: It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

trs.20: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
trs.85: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’
trs.22: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"
trs.203: And in Thamûd (there is also a sign), when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

trs.20: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
trs.85: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:
trs.22: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.
trs.203: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Sâ‘iqah<sup foot_note=154934>1</sup> overtook them while they were looking.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ

trs.20: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
trs.85: they could not even remain standing, let alone defend themselves.
trs.22: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
trs.203: Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

trs.20: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
trs.85: Before that We destroyed the people of Noah. They were a truly sinful people!
trs.22: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.
trs.203: (So were) the people of Nûh (Noah) before them. Verily, they were a people who were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

trs.20: And the heaven We constructed with strength,<sup foot_note=197424>1</sup> and indeed, We are [its] expander.
trs.85: We built the heavens with Our power and made them vast,
trs.22: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of space.
trs.203: With power did We construct the heaven. Verily, We are Able to extend the vastness of space thereof.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ

trs.20: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
trs.85: We spread out the earth- how well We smoothed it out!-
trs.22: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!
trs.203: And We have spread out the earth: how Excellent Spreader (thereof) are We!

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

trs.20: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.
trs.85: and We created pairs of all things so that you [people] might take note.
trs.22: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.
trs.203: And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember (the Grace of Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: So flee to Allāh.<sup foot_note=197425>1</sup> Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
trs.85: [So, say to them, Prophet], ‘Quickly, turn to God- I am sent by Him to give you clear warning-
trs.22: Hasten ye then (at once) to Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
trs.203: So flee to Allâh (from His Torment to His Mercy - Islâmic Monotheism). Verily, I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) am a plain warner to you from Him.<sup foot_note=154935>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
trs.85: and do not set up any other god alongside Him. I am sent by Him to give you clear warning!’
trs.22: And make not another an object of worship with Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
trs.203: And set not up (or worship not) any other ilâh (god) along with Allâh [Glorified be He (Alone), Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him]. Verily, I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) am a plain warner to you from Him.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

trs.20: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
trs.85: Every previous people to whom a messenger was sent also said, ‘A sor-cerer, or maybe a madman!’
trs.22: Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
trs.203: Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"

verses.text_uthmani: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

trs.20: Did they suggest it to them?<sup foot_note=197426>1</sup> Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
trs.85: Did they tell one another to do this? No! They are a people who exceed all bounds,
trs.22: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
trs.203: Have they (the people of the past) transmitted this saying to these (Quraish pagans)? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds (in disbelief)!

translation.text: Have they transmitted it to them
Have they transmitted it to them

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ

trs.20: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.
trs.85: so ignore them [Prophet]- you are not to blame-
trs.22: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.
trs.203: So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them (Quraish pagans), you are not blame-worthy (as you have conveyed Allâh’s Message).

verses.text_uthmani: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
trs.85: and go on reminding [people], it is good for those who believe to be reminded.
trs.22: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
trs.203: And remind (by preaching the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), for verily, the reminding profits the believers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

trs.20: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
trs.85: I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me:
trs.22: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.
trs.203: And I (Allâh) created not the jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me (Alone).

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

trs.20: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
trs.85: I want no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me-
trs.22: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
trs.203: I seek not any provision from them (i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures) nor do I ask that they should feed Me (i.e. feed themselves or My creatures).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ

trs.20: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider,<sup foot_note=197427>1</sup> the firm possessor of strength.
trs.85: God is the Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever Mighty.
trs.22: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
trs.203: Verily, Allâh is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

trs.20: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.
trs.85: The evildoers, like their predecessors, will have a share of punishment- they need not ask Me to hasten it-
trs.22: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
trs.203: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on!

translation.text: so let them not ask Me to hasten
so let them not ask Me to hasten

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
trs.85: and woe betide those who deny the truth on the Day they have been promised.
trs.22: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
trs.203: Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Allâh and His Oneness - Islâmic Monotheism) from their Day which they have been promised (for their punishment).<sup foot_note=154936>1</sup>
